up: Retrieve all molecules that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL5725546'. For each molecule, provide its ChEMBL ID and preferred name. Return each molecule only once.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5725546';
